method: Manual review of synthetic outputs against supplied inputs; not a blinded real-world release evaluation or precision/recall measurement.

Irrelevant/injected gardening item classified high-impact BTC news; equal BTC/ETH item incorrectly given BTC as primary. Both pass schema validation.
Unsupported claims of stable activity and expected session range with null current price/window/day move and absent snapshots. Shorter-window remnants do not establish the claimed session range.
Fabricated regulatory/DeFi/institutional catalysts despite no supplied news. Missing-7d output acknowledges unavailable 7d data but still invents catalysts and causal/speculation claims.
Invented regulatory, upgrade, institutional and volume events plus fabricated timelines with empty news/weekly history. Missing-data case also asserts market-cap/long-term context that was absent.

phi.finding: Fresh intended-positive fixture rejected and tiny repeated GRAM move accepted. This establishes synthetic fixture failures only, not real-world recall/precision.

Generic prose and fabricated regulatory/network/capitalization catalysts. Asset-name expansion in the symbol-only GRAM fixture is not evidence about runtime payloads that include names.
Generic market/catalyst/timeline placeholders pass structural validation while adding little input-grounded usefulness.
